description: Park a workstream the user means to return to. Mints a short key and returns a line to hand them verbatim. Unlike knowl_handoff, this is not consumed by resuming and works from any directory, any number of sessions later.

artifactRefs.description: Files the returning session should look at.

blocker.description: What is in the way, if anything.

goal.description: What this workstream is trying to achieve.

nextAction.description: The next step as it stands now.

sessionId.description: The session parking this work, if known, so the brief can point at its transcript.

verificationStatus.description: Whether the work so far was checked.

name: knowl_park
